The measured abundances of Na, K, S, and Al2O3 at individual observation IDs at the Chandrayaan-314 landing site. Additionally, the table includes the average abundance of Na, K, S, and Al2O3 in individual
soil samples collected from Apollo62, Luna 2062, and Chang’e-512,13 missions. Please note that the data for only those Apollo samples for which Na, K, and S abundances were measured have been included
in this study62.
